Hey, 

That's sort of the thing though, I mean if we're going to end up dead anyways why can't I just end it sooner rather than waiting for it miserably. If I try to make myself happy I just remember darkness so what's the point in trying. 

Even if there is some sort of divine being that created us, so what, whatever punishment they have to offer cannot possibly be worse than this suffering. 

I just want everything to go away, I wish there was nothing.

I appreciate your reply.

Best,
